newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea ruling party seeks delay in fin. reforms.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea ruling party seeks delay in fin. reforms.

text.p: South Korea's ruling New Korea Party has asked the government to postpone legislation for financial reforms being proposed by a presidential commission, a party official said on Thursday.

The party believed the government needed more time to handle the proposals that included key issues such as the central bank's independence, industrial conglomerates' participation in bank management and mergers of financial companies, he said.
The official quoted Kim Zoong-wie, chairman of the party's policy committee, as saying the proposal contained "controversial issues". No details were given.
